name: F11: a guest's link dies at the Stormheart claim acknowledgement; no duplicated grant
claim: ACCEPTANCE F11 'accept/refuse independently ... through disconnect/reload, without duplicated grants', the saved-character acknowledgement window. Both players fought the Dynamo. The host says Yes. The guest opens its own offer and says Yes through the real dialogue. The existing adapter closes its actual connected ENet transport synchronously in SaveGame's prepared_character_completed TRUE_BOOL callback, after authenticating the original live save call, immutable request, scoped frozen owner state, single answer transaction receipt and written character bytes, before the save returns to the ending_settled sender. The host holds no world receipt of the guest's answer and its one guest claim remains unsettled. The guest rejoins as the same character with the saved answer; the host settles the original claim as ACCEPTED. The guest holds exactly one Stormheart. A repeated claim is refused before and after reload, with no duplicate grant. Setup: a declared-start host save with an open Stormwood route and empty team, isolated initial Hall positioning/open route/Home Key, and the Dynamo ledger fixture that establishes act_ii_complete and marrow_defeated; no earned route or boss-play credit. Travel uses real host-authorized portal permits. A local close() sends an ENet disconnect; this proves a saved-character ACK drop, not a silent partition. Not covered: host disconnect, pre-save disconnect, silent timeout, or rejoin beyond the 120 s seat hold.
